只读跟随 Jusic 听歌房（happy.alang.run）：房间正在播放和待: Follow a Jusic listening room (happy.alang.run) read-only: the room's now-playing song and its queue show up here and play in the app; search browses the room's catalogue.
房间连不上，稍后重试: The room is not answering, try again in a moment
房间连接被服务端关闭: The server closed the room connection
房间里现在没有在放的歌: The room is not playing anything right now
房间里搜不到结果，稍后重试: The room's search found nothing, try again in a moment
房间只给正在播放和队列里的歌签直链，这首要点进房间才能播: The room only signs links for what it is playing and what is queued; this one has to be picked in the room to play
换一个房间就是在设置里改房间 ID: Another room is a different Room ID in the settings
房间里排着的歌，每首都能在 App 里直接放: The songs the room queued, each plays right here
只读跟随房间：正在播放和队列里的歌在这里同步播放，不往房间投歌。: Following the room read-only: its playing and queued songs play here, and nothing is sent back to the room.
在设置里把「房间 ID」改成想进的房间，密码房间还要填密码: Set the Room ID in the settings; a password room asks for its password too
只影响搜索结果来自哪个曲库。搜到的条目是元数据，播放要等它进了房间队列。: Only picks which catalogue the search reads from. What it finds is metadata; playing waits until the room queues it.
默认 DEFAULT（公开的「一起听歌吧」）。首页第一屏底部的「打开房间列表」里: DEFAULT is the public room. The Show the rooms link on Home lists other room IDs; put one here to follow it.
只对需要密码的房间有用；公开房间留空即可。: Only for a room that asks for one; leave it empty for an open room.
按在线人数排的前 80 个房间；把想要的 ID 填进设置里的「房间 ID」就能换: The 80 rooms with the most listeners; put one's ID in the Room ID setting to follow it
